detail.longDescription: A look inside my three-node K3s homelab, why all three nodes participate in the control plane, and how I use GitOps, storage, recovery, secrets, policy, and observability to practice real failure modes. # kubernetes # devops # homelab # gitops # software # coding # development # engineering # inclusive # community Inside My 3-Node K3s Homelab: The Platform I Use to Test Production Patterns
